**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Sir](../persons.html#2292)
I am sorry to say that I did not keep the address of the author of that excellent catechism I have enquired for it several times, but have never been able to recover it, much to my regret.
I have a copy of the account of the Hursley Church windows written out by [Miss Keble](../persons.html#796), the sister, which I suppose is the same as the one of which you kindly offer me a sight, and as I have one way or another a good deal of writing of [Mr Keble](../persons.html#798)’s I will not trouble you to risk yours[^2]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to The Revd/ H.

Dombrain/ Framilode Rectory/ Stonehouse/Gloucester.

[^2]: The document referred to, an account of the Hursley windows in Keble’s hand, is with the letter in Gloucestershire Record Office.
